messages:
zoe: Heads-up: new SLO translation landed in staging and we're seeing lots of low-severity dup alerts for tenant:velox. Looks like translation created multiple sibling rules.
ram: saw that. fanout multiplies across routes and notify pipeline sends them all. Noise is drowning real hits.
pavan: quick mitigation idea: soft attenuation at notify ingress per-tenant. Not hard drop, but probabilistic delivery once a burst threshold is crossed. Keeps visibility but reduces spike fanout.
zoe: I like "attenuation" as a user-facing term (less scary than drop). UI needs to show when it's active and why. Maybe a tiny "attenuated" chip with reason on the alert card and timeline entry.
ram: API sketch: POST /v2/notify -> response includes `attenuation` object: {applied:true,policy:"burst_shaper",sample:0.3,reason:"translated_cluster"}. Clients can show badge.
pavan: telemetry: export `notify.attenuated.count` and `notify.attenuated.sample_rate` with tenant tag. Also `notify.attenuated.unblock_burst` to catch thundering unblocks.
zoe: storage: short-lived Redis keys keyed by tenant for token buckets; keep hottest N in-process. TTLs and occasional compaction.
ram: RBAC: add an oncall bypass toggle in console for tenants where attenuation hides noise. Bypass should be auditable and timeboxed.
pavan: rollout: default off. Enable for 2% of noisy tenants in staging, then 10% after 24h. Console will list experiment participants and allow opt-in.
ui-bot: added checklist: API spec, telemetry, Redis schema, console chip mock, bypass endpoint + audit, rollout plan doc.
zoe: Please enum the reasons: `translated_cluster`, `tenant_burst`, `quota_spill`. Machine-readable for metrics aggregation and user-friendly mapping in UI.
ram: I'll wire the response header and metrics. pavan: I'll prototype the console chip and experiment table. Sync 11am tomorrow to handoff tasks. :thumbsup:
